name: Math Kangaroo
description: International Kangaroo of Mathematics, all levels (Austrian and other official English editions, Kangaroo Canada).
scoringNote: 3, 4 or 5 points per question by difficulty; no penalty for wrong answers (Math Kangaroo USA rules).

name: Noetic
description: Noetic Learning Math Contest (grades 2-8), free sample and past tests.

name: Math Olympiad (MOEMS)
description: Math Olympiads for Elementary and Middle Schools, Division E (grades 4-6) and Division M (grades 6-8).
scoringNote: 1 point per question (a real contest is 5 problems in about 30 minutes, each with its own time limit).
